preconditions.description: The length of the input word s must be between 1 and 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input word s must consist only of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == s.lower() if sum(1 for c in s if c.islower()) >= sum(1 for c in s if c.isupper()) else s.upper()
postconditions.description: The output must be the input word s converted to lowercase if there are at least as many lowercase letters as uppercase letters, otherwise converted to uppercase.
